title: Healthchecks
description: Solution-wide health overview as a pure consumer of the results layer (Result Envelope v1): rule counts per state over the static-code-analysis and metadata-integrity rule dashboards, grouped by rubric, each row linking into its rule dashboard. Reads only the server result cache — never executes rule SQL on page load; pending entries have not been run against the current catalog yet and stay visible until an explicit run. Deliberately carries NO result declaration itself (consumer, not rule — chipless by design).
author: fm-lab core

datasets.description: Combined top node ('' path, row 1) + per-rubric nodes over both rule subtrees — feeds the hero KPI strip and coverage. Cache-only, never executes SQL.

params.name: state
params.description: Result-state filter (error | warning | ok | neutral | pending | failed, comma-separated), set by clicking a hero KPI. Empty = all.
